resources.name: Crystal structure of BaCu2Si2O7 (powder X-ray)

access.notes: Yamada, T., Hiroi, Z., Takano, M. (2001) J. Solid State Chem. 156, 101. Atomic coordinates and cell parameters available in ICSD or COD.

resources.notes: Full unit-cell parameters and fractional coordinates for all atoms (Ba, Cu, Si, O) are required.

resources.name: Crystal structure of BaCu2Ge2O7 (powder X-ray)

access.notes: Same paper by Yamada et al. 2001; separate entry for the germinate.

resources.notes: Full unit-cell parameters and fractional coordinates for all atoms (Ba, Cu, Ge, O) are required.

resources.name: Shannon ionic radii (CN=6)

access.notes: Shannon, R.D. (1976) Acta Cryst. A32, 751-767. Widely tabulated; key radii given in the approach.

resources.notes: Key values: Cu²⁺ 0.73, O²⁻ 1.40, Si⁴⁺ 0.40, Ge⁴⁺ 0.53 (Å). For Ba²⁺ consult the standard table.
